description: This file defines the Logarithms class which provides static methods for calculating various logarithmic functions such as logarithm with a specified base, base-10 logarithm, and natural logarithm. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Logarithms
classes.description: A class providing static methods for logarithmic calculations used in spreadsheet formulas.

methods.name: withBase
methods.description: Calculates the logarithm of a number to a specified base, defaulting to 10, with validation and support for array inputs.

methods.name: base10
methods.description: Calculates the base-10 logarithm of a number, with validation and support for arrays.

methods.name: natural
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm (ln) of a number, with validation and support for arrays.
